title: A Volunteer Shift at the Community Library
instructions: 这是为中文成人英语初学者（A1，第5周）编写的原创模拟阅读材料，主题为日常安排与习惯。请先阅读短文，再完成8道阅读题。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。材料为模拟教学用途，非官方考试。
passage: A: My name is Lily. I volunteer at the community library on Saturdays. I go there at nine o'clock in the morning. I help put books on the shelves. I work with two other volunteers. We are a team. We start at nine and finish at twelve. We take a short break at ten thirty. We drink tea and talk. B: My friend Tom volunteers on Sundays. He works from ten to two. He reads to children. The children listen and smile. They like Tom. They ask many questions. Tom answers slowly. C: We all love the library. We meet new people. We learn new things. We are happy volunteers.

questions.evidence: I volunteer at the community library on Saturdays.

answers: At nine o'clock in the morning

questions.evidence: I go there at nine o'clock in the morning.

questions.prompt: What does Lily help do at the library?
questions.explanation: 第一段说“I help put books on the shelves.”，所以是帮忙把书放到书架上。
questions.evidence: I help put books on the shelves.

questions.prompt: How many other volunteers work with Lily?
questions.explanation: 第一段说“I work with two other volunteers.”，所以是另外两名志愿者。
questions.evidence: I work with two other volunteers.

questions.prompt: What time do Lily and her team take a break?
questions.explanation: 第一段说“We take a short break at ten thirty.”，所以是十点半休息。
questions.evidence: We take a short break at ten thirty.

options: He puts books on the shelves
questions.explanation: 第二段说“He reads to children.”，所以Tom给孩子们读书。
第二段说“My friend Tom volunteers on Sundays.”，所以Tom星期天做志愿者。
questions.evidence: My friend Tom volunteers on Sundays.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word from the passage: We ______ new people.
questions.explanation: 第三段说“We meet new people.”，所以填meet。

grammar.title: 一般现在时：I / you / we / they 的实义动词
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常发生的动作或习惯。当主语是 I、you、we、they 时，实义动词用原形，不加 -s。例如：I go, you help, we start, they like。否定句用 don't + 动词原形，例如：We don't work on Sundays. 疑问句用 Do + 主语 + 动词原形？例如：Do you volunteer here? 时间表达如 at nine o'clock, on Saturdays 常与一般现在时连用。
grammar.example: We start at nine and finish at twelve.

options: I go to the library on Saturdays.
I goes to the library on Saturdays.
I going to the library on Saturdays.
answers: I go to the library on Saturdays.
questions.explanation: 主语是 I，实义动词用原形 go，所以选第一句。
questions.evidence: I go there at nine o'clock in the morning.

questions.explanation: 主语是 we，动词用原形 help，所以选第一句。
questions.evidence: I help put books on the shelves.

questions.explanation: 主语是 they，动词用原形 like，所以选第一句。
主语是 you，动词用原形 start，所以选第一句。
questions.evidence: We start at nine and finish at twelve.

questions.explanation: 主语是 we，否定用 don't + 动词原形，所以选第一句。
questions.evidence: We start at nine and finish at twelve.

questions.explanation: 主语是 you，一般现在时疑问句用 Do + 主语 + 动词原形，所以选第一句。
questions.evidence: I volunteer at the community library on Saturdays.

questions.explanation: 主语是 they，否定用 don't + 动词原形，所以选第一句。
主语是 we，动词用原形 meet，所以选第一句。
